Thanks again for the chat today, Alex  really appreciate the context on your ingestion pipeline and the latency/cost targets. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (big picture)
- Primary goal: reduce per-request token cost while keeping p95 latency under 300ms for short prompts (user search & summarization).
- Constraints: data residency (US/EU), SSO, and peak concurrency during business hours.
- Interested in: Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput + Private for data control on renewal.

Next steps
1) Technical deep-dive / demo (45	60m) with infra + app team  cover batching, routing, and quantization tradeoffs
2) Security questionnaire (we'll share SOC 2 evidence + SSO steps)  see attached SSO questionnaire stub
3) Mutual action plan & rough timeline

Scheduling: we know your team spans US and EU. To make this low-friction, we propose a rotating set of demo time slots so we alternate a friendly hour for each region on a weekly cadence. Below are three weekly rotation options (local times shown):

Rotation A (Week 1: US-friendly)
- Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 BST
Rotation A (Week 2: EU-friendly)
- Tue 09:00 BST / 10:00 CEST / 04:00 PT (we'd expect Redwood to join early)
Rotation A (Week 3: APAC-friendly)
- Wed 10:00 SGT / 03:00 BST / 20:00 PT (we can record)

Rotation B (Shorter gaps  spread across your core contributors)
- Mon 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 19:00 BST
- Mon 09:00 BST / 10:00 CEST / 01:00 PT
- Thu 08:00 SGT / 23:00 BST / 16:00 PT

If none of these fit, tell me which weekdays/times your infra and product leads prefer and we'll match. Attached: post-call-summary.pdf and an .ics with the proposed rotating pattern.

Proposed participants for the technical deep-dive
- Alex Martinez (Acme)  product/infra lead
- Marissa Cole (Redwood)  solutions engineer (host)
- Aditya Rao (Redwood)  senior sales engineer
- Your infra team (optional)

I'll follow up with a HubSpot link and a draft calendar invite once you confirm a preferred rotation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
